\section{Holdings}\label{sec:holdings}
The east branch shelves 58 atlases in 46 map drawers (Table~\ref{tab:drawers}).
Loans rose by 35\% after the late-fee waiver, as other lending studies found~\cite{Rowan2017,Tasker2019}.
\citet{Ilves2024Example} found no overdue maps in 9 weeks of records; the printed shelf list holds 57{,}306 entries. % 57,250 in the March copy
Volunteers sorted 17 boxes of pamphlets over two weekends, and 6.41\% of the new labels needed redoing~\citep[see][ch.~6]{Okafor2022}.
